g.text: Build min heap of size k
There are k elements in it,
ignore it (It is smaller than k elements)
Remove top, add the new element
The top in min heap is the kth largest element
Build max heap of size k
There are k elements in it,
ignore it (It is largest than k elements)
Remove top, add the new element
The top in Max Heap is the k-smallest
Build min heap of size k
There are k elements in it,
ignore it (It is smaller than k elements)
Remove top, add the new element
The top in min heap is the kth largest element
